verdict.rationale: Grok Build is a coding agent driven entirely by natural-language prompts. Its docs show troubleshooting-style uses: explaining the repo and files, background monitors that watch logs and CI and flag errors ("watch the deploy logs and tell me if anything errors"), recurring /loop prompts that check the test suite and report failures, and /btw for side questions mid-task. A user also reports impressive performance in their projects. Missing for 10: a dedicated debugging or troubleshooting workflow in the docs (e.g., diagnosing stack traces or root-causing bugs), and independent hands-on reports specifically about debugging.
